summary: Maximum-value v2: FCRA §1681b(b)(2)(A) procurement disclosure + ICRAA §1786.16 are audit-gated; FCRA §1681b(b)(3), PC §290.46(j), and ICRAA §1786.40 are reserved for verified post-report adverse/use facts. UCL and Tameny failure-to-hire dropped.

counts.title: FCRA 15 U.S.C. §1681b(b)(2)(A) — employment consumer-report procurement without compliant standalone disclosure
ICRAA Civ. Code §§1786.16, 1786.50 — defective/missing pre-procurement investigative-report disclosure
FCRA 15 U.S.C. §1681b(b)(3)(A) — post-report adverse action without pre-adverse report / Summary of Rights
Penal Code §290.46(j)(2)(E), (j)(4)(A) — actual employment use of California-registry-sourced information
ICRAA Civ. Code §§1786.40, 1786.50 — denial-time advice requirements

dropped.title: UCL, Bus. & Prof. Code §17200
dropped.reason: Low incremental value; expected wages are a poor restitution fit and the equitable claim adds an avoidable Rule 12 target.
